summary: Touhoi Fok was a scholar of Buddhist studies, philosophy, and Sinology who studied at the New Asia Institute of Advanced Chinese Studies, Otani University, and The Chinese University of Hong Kong, where he also lectured from circa 1972 to 1988.

Touraj Daryaee is a historian of Iranian and Central Asian studies. He studied under Michael Gregory Morony at the University of California, Los Angeles, and held a post at the University of California, Irvine around 2007.

Towao Sakaehara is a Japanese history scholar who earned his doctorate from Kyoto University. He taught at Otemon Gakuin University and Osaka City University, and served as director of the Osaka Museum of History from 2014 to 2020.
Tracy Franz is a Buddhist studies scholar attested in 2018 as a teacher at Dalhousie University and as an English teacher at Shokei University.

Travis L. Smith is an Indology and religious studies scholar. He studied at UC Berkeley and Columbia University, working under scholars including Vasudha Dalmia and John Stratton Hawley, and held posts at Barnard College and the University of Florida.
Trent Walker is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies who earned his PhD at the University of California, Berkeley, under the supervision of Alexander von Rospatt.

Trevor Leggett was a Buddhist studies, Japanology, and Indology scholar. He studied at King's College London, SOAS, and under Arthur Waley and Hari Prasad Shastri, later heading the BBC Japanese Service and lecturing at The Buddhist Society.

Trijang Rinpoche was a Tibetan Buddhist scholar who studied at Gyuto Monastery and under Pabongkhapa Dechen Nyingpo. He served as a teacher at Ganden Shartse Monastery, instructing figures including Tenzin Gyatso, the 14th Dalai Lama.
Trinle Lhundrub was a scholar who studied under Dilgo Khyentse and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje.
Tro Shul Khenpo Jampal Dorjé studied under Shechen Gyaltsab and Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö.
Troy Organ was a philosophy and Indology scholar who studied at the University of Iowa. He held positions at Parsons College, the University of Akron, Chatham University, and Ohio University.

Trulshik Rinpoche was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology figure who studied under Dilgo Khyentse and Dudjom Rinpoche, among others. He taught numerous students, including Tenzin Gyatso and Adam Pearcey.
Trung Huynh is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies who completed a PhD at the University of the West under the supervision of Darui Long.

Trungram Gyaltrul is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar. He studied at Karma Shri Nalanda Institute and earned a PhD from Harvard University under Leonard van der Kuijp, and founded the United Trungram Buddhist Foundation and Fellowship.

Trungram Gyalwa Rinpoche is a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Karma Shri Nalanda Institute, Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, and Harvard University. He has held visiting positions at the University of Michigan and McGill University.

Tryambakarama Sastri was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied under Lakshmana Sastri Dravida at Government Sanskrit College, Varanasi. He served as head of Government Sanskrit Pathashala, Jamnagar, attested in 1932.
Tré Khen Zur Lozang Wangchuk studied under the 13th Dalai Lama, Trijang Rinpoche, and Tenzin Gyatso.
Trịnh Xuân Thuận is a religious studies scholar who studied at the California Institute of Technology and Princeton University, before taking up a post at the University of Virginia circa 1979.

Tse-fu Kuan is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a doctorate at the University of Oxford under Richard Gombrich. He conducted postdoctoral research at National Cheng Kung University and held a post at Yuan Ze University.
Tsenshab Serkong Rinpoche was a Tibetan Buddhist scholar who studied at Ganden Monastery, held a post at Ganden Jangtse Monastery, and taught Tenzin Gyatso, Alexander Berzin, and Thubten Chodron.
